【原视频简介】
This is our hands-on director's test of the Seed model family: Seedance 2.5, Seedream 5.0 Pro, and Seed Audio 1.0, used together to produce a short film. These models can be experienced on Lumina by BytePlus (here’s the link: https://bit.ly/byteplus-lumina-yt-sd) and accessed via API through BytePlus, the sponsor of this video. 

We watch the result first, then break down exactly how we built it, with Seedance 2.5, Seedream 5.0 Pro and Seed Audio 1.0  and give our honest verdict: is this workflow actually enough for a professional AI film production? 

We cover main characteristics of the three models and assess their output quality, prompt adherence, the level of control, editability, consistency, and overall usefulness in a professional workflow.

This video is for filmmakers and AI video creators evaluating whether this workflow can realistically replace a fragmented production stack, not just for testing raw generation quality.
